title: Kullu–Manali – The Himalayan Paradise
overview: Escape to the mountains with TripWithMe on an unforgettable 5 Nights / 6 Days group trip through Kullu, Manali, and Kasol. Explore Hadimba Devi Temple, Van Vihar, Manali Mall Road, Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel, and the scenic landscapes around Sissu or Khoksar when weather and road conditions permit. Visit Naggar Castle in Kullu Valley, enjoy the peaceful riverside atmosphere of Kasol, and seek blessings at Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara. Optional adventure activities such as river rafting and paragliding may be available at additional cost. Travel with fellow explorers, make new friends, and create beautiful Himalayan memories.

itinerary.title: Delhi Departure | Overnight Journey to Manali
activities: Meet your fellow travelers at the designated boarding point in Delhi and get ready for an exciting Himalayan adventure.
Board your Volvo bus or traveler and begin your journey towards the beautiful mountains of Himachal Pradesh.
Enjoy music, DJ, fun activities, group bonding, and memorable moments with fellow travelers during the journey.
Relax during the overnight journey as you travel towards Manali.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali | Local Sightseeing
activities: Arrive in Manali and transfer to your hotel for check-in, subject to hotel availability.
Freshen up, enjoy breakfast, and get ready to explore the beautiful hill town of Manali.
Visit the famous Hadimba Devi Temple, surrounded by beautiful cedar forests and peaceful mountain views.
Explore Van Vihar, a beautiful nature park perfect for relaxing and enjoying the greenery.
Visit the vibrant Mall Road for shopping, local food, and exploring Manali's lively atmosphere.
Enjoy your visit to Club House, a popular spot for leisure and recreational activities.
Return to the hotel, enjoy dinner, and relax with a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Excursion | Atal Tunnel & Sissu
activities: Wake up to the refreshing mountain atmosphere and enjoy breakfast at the hotel.
Head towards Solang Valley, famous for its breathtaking Himalayan landscapes and adventure activities.
Enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery and take photographs against the stunning natural backdrop.
Continue towards the iconic Atal Tunnel, subject to weather, road conditions, and local permissions.
If conditions permit, explore the beautiful village of Sissu or Khoksar and enjoy its scenic mountain views.
Adventure activities, if available, can be enjoyed at additional charges.
Return to the hotel in Manali, enjoy dinner, and relax overnight.

itinerary.title: Naggar Castle & Kullu | Transfer to Kasol
activities: Start your morning with breakfast at the hotel and complete the checkout formalities.
Travel towards the beautiful Kullu Valley and enjoy scenic views along the way.
Visit the historic Naggar Castle, known for its traditional Himalayan architecture and mountain views.
Enjoy optional adventure activities such as river rafting and paragliding, subject to availability and at an additional cost.
Continue your journey towards Kasol, a beautiful destination nestled along the Parvati River.
Check in to your hotel or camp and enjoy the peaceful mountain surroundings.
Have dinner and relax during your overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol Exploration | Manikaran Sahib | Return to Delhi
activities: Wake up to the peaceful atmosphere of Kasol and enjoy breakfast at your hotel or camp.
Complete the checkout formalities and get ready to explore the spiritual and scenic beauty of the region.
Visit the sacred Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara, renowned for its spiritual significance and natural hot springs.
Explore Kasol Local Market, browse local shops, and enjoy the charming atmosphere of this popular mountain destination.
Spend some free time capturing photographs, enjoying the riverside views, and collecting memories of your trip.
As per the scheduled departure time, board your Volvo bus or traveler for the overnight return journey to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | End of a Memorable Trip
activities: Arrive in Delhi after your overnight journey from Himachal Pradesh, subject to traffic and travel conditions.
Say goodbye to your fellow travelers with beautiful memories, amazing photographs, and new friendships.
Thank you for being a part of the TripWithMe family. We look forward to exploring more destinations with you.
Travel More • Explore More • Live More!

faq.question: What are the main attractions covered in this Kullu-Manali-Kasol trip?
faq.answer: Explore the beautiful Himalayan destinations with TripWithMe! This trip covers Manali's famous Hadimba Devi Temple, Van Vihar, Mall Road, Club House, Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel, and the scenic beauty of Sissu (subject to weather and road conditions). You will also visit Kullu, Naggar Castle, Kasol, and the sacred Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara. Enjoy breathtaking mountain views, local culture, adventure, and unforgettable group travel experiences.

faq.question: What is the best time to visit Kullu, Manali, and Kasol?
faq.answer: Kullu, Manali, and Kasol are beautiful destinations throughout the year. March to June is ideal for pleasant weather, sightseeing, and outdoor activities. December to February is popular for experiencing winter landscapes and possible snowfall, depending on weather conditions. July to September brings monsoon rains, so travel plans and sightseeing may be affected by road conditions. Always check the weather before your journey.

faq.question: What activities can I enjoy during this trip?
faq.answer: 🏔️ Enjoy breathtaking Himalayan mountain views 🎿 Explore Solang Valley and experience optional adventure activities 🌉 Travel through the scenic Atal Tunnel 📸 Capture beautiful moments in Manali and Kasol 🙏 Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara 🛍️ Explore Mall Road and Kasol's local market 🤝 Meet new people, enjoy group bonding, and create unforgettable memories. Adventure activities such as paragliding and river rafting are optional and may cost extra.
